_about: Toolchain manifest for the AI & Frontier Tech dashboard refresh pipeline. restore.py reads this to rebuild an empty /home/claude after the ephemeral cloud container is reclaimed. Paths are relative to the repo's scripts/ folder; 'dest' is the filename restore.py writes into the workspace.

code.role: kalshi.json -> derived PM cards, settled db, history append; prints ROLL DUE lines
auto-roll a settled stock_pm market to the next period (pick / roll)
consolidated Playwright regression; run: timeout 110 node t_all.js
price-patch TEMPLATE (copy per run, edit result-file names + NOW/RSI/marks)
prompt builder TEMPLATE — incremental midday scope
Ornn compute prices -> dashboard_data_v3.json['compute'] (seed | gpu | lab | live); history append-only by date

project_only_data.role: per-run company/index/sector data (~1.4MB) — ALWAYS take the project copy, it is the newest
per-run Kalshi state incl. history, archives, settled db

Alpha Vantage 3-month earnings calendar, pulled on the 10am run and CONSUMED by the 1pm/5pm runs. WITHOUT IT build_events.py silently degrades every corporate earnings row to a Stocklake stub (no EPS estimate, no fiscal-quarter title) — it fails quietly, so always restore it.

project_only_extras.role: template: add a new stock_pm block + earnings-call mentions book
template: shared date-curve markets (quantum, US-stake board)
template: add a hosted Deep Research report (text_body + card entry)
the runbook — read the last section for the most recent run
the authoritative per-run instructions; the armed trigger names the file

notes: Deep Research report bodies live in the repo under reports/ and are served by Vercel; refresh runs never touch them and restore.py does not fetch them.
The cloud container cannot reach ai-frontier-dashboard.vercel.app (egress proxy 403) but CAN reach raw.githubusercontent.com — that is why restore.py fetches from GitHub raw.
